summary_fa: این تغییر روش بازبینی خودکار درخواست‌ها را بهتر می‌کند (زمان دقیق و پیشنهاد قابل‌ثبت)، اما فایل نتیجهٔ بازبینی اشتباهاً داخل خود پروژه ذخیره شده و می‌تواند بررسی همهٔ درخواست‌های بعدی را به‌صورت نادرست مسدود کند. تا زمانی که این فایل حذف نشود، ادغام امن نیست.
action_fa: به دستیار بگویید فایل نتیجهٔ بازبینی را حذف و در فهرست نادیده‌گرفته‌ها ثبت کند، سپس دوباره بررسی و Merge کنید.
summary: The formal-review publish step is well structured (SHA-pinned action, fail-closed missing JSON, cleanup after submit, line-aware dedupe), but the PR accidentally commits the reviewer output file, which the workflow will later read back from the repository as if it were a fresh result. Remove the artifact, gitignore it, and add a freshness guard before trusting the file.
traps_checked: Trap 11 (CI workflows: third-party action pinned to full SHA f28e40c… verified as v7.1.0, job timeout 25 > sum of step timeouts 20, [bot] actor-loop guard present) and Trap 7 (git diff --check clean) checked. Traps 1-6, 8-10 not relevant — no app, transcription, storage, realtime or UI code changed.

findings.title: Reviewer output file is committed and will be read back as a live gate input
findings.plain_fa: نتیجهٔ بازبینی به‌اشتباه داخل خود پروژه ذخیره شده است. این فایل بعداً به‌جای نتیجهٔ تازه خوانده می‌شود و می‌تواند هر درخواست جدید را بی‌دلیل قرمز و مسدود کند.
findings.body: Commit 2ef82e6 (`opencode-agent[bot]`) committed the model output into the repo root, even though the new prompt explicitly says `do NOT stage or commit any output file`. The publish step reads exactly `.opencode-review-result.json` via `fs.existsSync` (workflow line 161), so after this lands on `main` every future PR checkout contains this stale `REQUEST_CHANGES` artifact. If a model fails to write the file (free models frequently do) or skips it because a file already exists, the gate publishes stale findings pointing at old workflow lines and fails the check — a permanent false red gate, and a stale `APPROVED` copy would conversely let a bad PR through. This also violates AGENTS.md §5 (no scratch artifacts on `main`) and §7 evidence layout. Fix: delete this file in the PR, add `.opencode-review-result.json` to `.gitignore`, and write the result outside the worktree (e.g. `$RUNNER_TEMP`) or clear any pre-existing copy before the review steps.

findings.title: Result file read from repo root with no freshness check
findings.plain_fa: برنامهٔ بازبینی هر فایلی با این نام را تازه فرض می‌کند. اگر فایل قدیمی یا ناقص باشد، نتیجهٔ اشتباه منتشر می‌شود؛ باید فقط نتیجهٔ همین اجرا پذیرفته شود.
findings.body: `fs.existsSync(resultPath)` accepts any `.opencode-review-result.json` present in the checkout, including a tracked copy from the base branch or a partially written file from an earlier failed attempt. Even after deleting the committed artifact, this remains a trust issue: a stale `APPROVED` with an empty `findings` array would pass the gate, while a stale `REQUEST_CHANGES` would block. Verify freshness against `startTs` (and ideally a `pr_number`/`run_id` field emitted by the model) before trusting the file, or write/read it under `process.env.RUNNER_TEMP` outside the repository so a tracked file can never be picked up.

findings.title: APPROVE→COMMENT fallback can leave an old REQUEST_CHANGES review blocking merge
findings.plain_fa: اگر ثبت «تأیید» رد شود و فقط به‌صورت کامنت ثبت شود، درخواست اصلاح قبلی ممکن است همچنان مانع ادغام بماند. بهتر است در این حالت وضعیت قبلی هم پاک شود.
findings.body: When the new verdict is APPROVED the code submits `event: 'APPROVE'`; if GitHub rejects it (repo settings), it silently retries as `COMMENT`. The previous run's `REQUEST_CHANGES` review from the same bot is not dismissed, so GitHub can keep the PR in "changes requested" state while the job reports success. Consider dismissing the bot's prior `REQUEST_CHANGES` review (or at least emitting a warning) when a new APPROVED verdict is published so the visible PR state matches the check.

findings.title: New publish step inherits unused OIDC and broad contents scope
findings.plain_fa: این مرحلهٔ جدید با دسترسی‌های بیشتر از نیاز اجرا می‌شود. کم‌کردن دسترسی‌های بی‌استفاده امنیت را بهتر می‌کند.
findings.body: `actions/github-script` runs with the job's token, which currently grants `contents: write` and `id-token: write`. No step uses OIDC, and the publish step only needs `pull-requests: write` / `issues: write`. Keep `contents: write` only if the OpenCode action genuinely pushes commits, and drop `id-token: write` (and `checks: read` if unused) to apply least privilege to a token exposed to LLM-driven steps.
